name: Alt Text Go
author: AltTextGo

sections.description:
Generate high-quality alt text for your images.

Improve your site’s accessibility, SEO, and content quality with one-click. Effortlessly add alt text to your images as you review them.

Features:

  • Effortless generation – Professional alt text written for you.
  • Best experience – Clear onboarding, easy setup, and responsive support team.
  • SEO keywords – Incorporate SEO keywords to alt text generation
  • Right in your posts – Simple, intuitive experience, get alt text done as you go through images before publishing.
  • Compliance – Improve accessibility with minimal effort.

Note: Since the alt text generation work is done by AltTextGo backend service, you will need to sign up for an account on our website to start generating alt text.
Try with your first 50 generations for free! Learn more about AltTextGo and our services here.

Support

Got questions? Let us know at support@alttexgo.com
sections.installation:
To get started:

  1. From WordPress Admin page, go to “Plugins” from left side bar, then click “Add New Plugin”
  2. Search for “Alt Text Go”, click “Install”, then “Activate”
  3. Go to AltTextGo website to sign up and create an API key with free credits
  4. Go back to WordPress -> “Alt Text Go”, paste the API key into plugin Settings Page.
  5. You are ready! Go to any image and generate alt text in one click.
